name: Downtown Dubai
blurb: Home to Burj Khalifa and Dubai Mall — the city's most iconic address.

name: Dubai Marina
blurb: Waterfront towers, yacht life, and one of Dubai's liveliest promenades.

name: Palm Jumeirah
blurb: The world-famous man-made island of beachfront villas and resorts.

name: Business Bay
blurb: Dubai's dynamic business hub on the canal, minutes from Downtown.

name: Dubai Hills Estate
blurb: Master-planned green community around an 18-hole championship golf course.

name: Jumeirah Village Circle
blurb: Family-friendly, high-yield community at the centre of New Dubai.

name: Dubai Creek Harbour
blurb: Waterfront masterplan facing the Ras Al Khor wildlife sanctuary.

name: Sheikh Zayed Road
blurb: Dubai's iconic business spine, lined with landmark towers and swift metro access to every district.
